description: Pilot: 70 headnotes for 20 federal court of appeals decisions, written by Claude agents in a cloud session from CourtListener text, to compare with the Haiku run of headnotes-circuits-v1 on the same decisions.

producer.method: Claude agents in a cloud session (4 workers in parallel), reading each opinion through the CourtListener API; not the Message Batches API.

input.source: CourtListener API, opinion html_with_citations (the lead opinion of each cluster), read in full.
input.paragraph_numbering: Count of blocks in CourtListener html_with_citations, caption lines included where present. Not build.py's numbering of graph.opinion_text.

selection: Haiku agent list 897, ranks 16881-16900 of request set headnotes-circuits-v1; all 20 were shown assembled into the Haiku results on 2026-11-25, so each has a Haiku answer to compare. Courts: ca4 x4, ca6 x3, ca7 x3, ca11 x3, ca8 x2, cafc x2, ca5, ca9, ca10. Dates 1915 to 2024.
compare_with: headnotes-circuits-v1 (Haiku run, not yet in this repository)

cost.note: Recovering the answer format from the Haiku run's transcript cost about 315,000 more tokens, once.

caveats: The prompt is a reconstruction from what the Haiku run's transcript showed, not the text of data/prompts/headnotes.md; where the Haiku agents reported a rule differently, the stricter version was used.
Concept slugs are guesses in the style of the headnotes-v2 taxonomy, which was not available; most will fail a slug check until remapped. Compare topics, not strings.

Paragraph numbers count blocks in CourtListener's html_with_citations, not build.py's paragraphs of graph.opinion_text, so treat them as approximate; each headnote's anchors give the first words of the cited paragraphs.

The Haiku requests were cut to about 48,000 bytes (first 36,000 and last 12,000); here whole opinions were read, so the four long ones (clusters 430606, 667661, 10036018, 771850) may have headnotes from text Haiku never saw.
The word limit used was 60; the Haiku agents reported limits between 60 and 75.
Cluster 10036018 (Joshi v. Garland): CourtListener's text came from a PDF, so its paragraph spans are rough.
Cluster 282376 (MacMillan Oil) is a short per curiam affirming on the district court's opinion; it got one real headnote rather than a no_holding status, and the Haiku run may differ.
producer.model is left null in this repository; the model is named in the pilot's own notes in the Starfield project folder.
extra.haiku_rank is the request's rank in headnotes-circuits-v1; extra.notes are the writer's notes on each decision.
